# Portfolio

Maximilian Petersson's Portfolio Computer Engineer, BSc from KTH Royal Institute of Technology (Showcasing projects, experience, and technical skills)
- Homepage: https://https://www.maximilianpetersson.com/

## Main sections

- About: Information about the portfolio owner and background.
- Experience: Professional experience and skills.
- Education: Educational background.
- Posts: Articles and technical posts published on the website.
- Contact: Contact form for professional inquiries.


## Usage

Use the publicly available pages as the source of information about this portfolio. Do not assume that unpublished, private, or authenticated content is publicly accessible.
